notes.title: Update to Version 1.42
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Finally posted a new update to the game, mostly fixing a bunch of smaller issues at this point. However, as part of the console porting process, I updated the game to a new version of Unity. This broke a ton of assets and took extra time to fix things. I think it's looking pretty good now and maybe even looks and plays a little better than on the old version. 

I also added a feature for users with disabilities. Additional notes in the readme file.

notes.content: Nominate us for the Sit Back and Relax category!

notes.title: Build 1.31 Release Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks, pretty minor update this time. Will probably wait a couple weeks or so for the next more substantial update. Here's the rundown on this new build:

-Fixed sky city buildings moving into position too fast during cutscene
-Fixed cave elevator pushing player into ground if they stand under it
-Disabled player re-entering cabin after puzzle solved
-Misc small bug fixes with gameplay and minor visual issues

notes.title: Build 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks, some updates today, with more coming soon!

-Improvements to text size, etc for Steam Deck display.
-Fixed flickering decal textures.
-Fixed issue where players could trigger NPC actions out of order on Biologist level.
-Disabled interaction with relic rings after puzzles are solved.
-Fixed multiple small bugs with gameplay and minor visual issues.

notes.title: Update for Build 1.23
notes.content: -Fixed a problem where opening notebook and closing very quickly would hide subtitles until game paused or inventory or notebook opened again.

notes.title: Update for Build 1.22
notes.content: Fixed bug where some audio was not playing at the Engineer encounter.

notes.title: Update Notes for Build 1.21
notes.content:
Hi folks! I just posted a new build that addresses some of the bigger issues:

[list]
[*] Added additional screen resolution options
[*] Pause menu now indicates time since last autosave
[*] Fixed issue with adding photo to inventory in the ocean fort
[*] Fixed overlapping text with some languages
[*] Fixed unable to scroll full height of some notebook entries
[*] Added 'Q' and 'E' as options for opening inventory and notepad
[*] Added a missing subtitle from the Engineer
[*] Misc minor visual and gameplay fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Subtitles Fixed in Build 1.20
notes.content: Subtitle timings should now be working for all non-EN users.

notes.title: Bug Report Form
notes.content:
Hi everybody! Thank you for playing Lifeless Moon.

If you run into a bug, we’d love to hear about it so that we can fix it ASAP.
For this, please report any issues  via the official Bug Report form, here:
[url=https://www.lifelessmoon.com/p/help.html#bugform]https://www.lifelessmoon.com/p/help.html#bugform[/url]

Note: Please only use this form to submit gameplay-related issues. For product-related issues (ie, keys aren’t working) please reach out to [url=support@serenityforge.com]support@serenityforge.com[/url]

notes.title: Lifeless Moon has landed on Steam!
notes.content:
We’re over the moon to share this news with you: Lifeless Moon has landed on Steam today!

[previewyoutube=ZdFERBDYPYY;full][/previewyoutube]

Lifeless Moon is an atmospheric 3D platformer that places you at the heart of a mysterious lunar expedition that draws inspiration from classic science fiction. You'll step into the boots of an Apollo-era astronaut and explore the aftermath of a peculiar 1970s experiment: an oddly familiar desert town...on the moon.

Lifeless Moon is the spiritual successor to the popular 2014 indie title Lifeless Planet. In this new adventure, you will explore anomalies, confront phenomena, and unlock mysteries on a much grander scale.

To celebrate this launch, we’re also introducing the Lifeless Worlds bundle. It includes both Lifeless Moon and Lifeless Planet, giving series newcomers the ultimate entrypoint into this enthralling saga.
Get ready to uncover the truth and challenge your perception of reality.

Buy now!
